          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "By utilising a few machines from Create, you'll be able to improve your item transportation and storage capabilities significantly. Later on once you progress into the Voltaic Age, you'll even be able to set up processes to automatically order specific items or route them around your base as needed!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "As this questline deals primarily with machines from Create, this means Pondering the machines will be your best source of information aside from these quests, so be sure to look through their entries.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Boxing Clever",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "all_started",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "When provided with a redstone signal, the Packager will wrap up items from the block it is attached to (you can switch the connection side with a wrench) and output a neat little cardboard package. Each cardboard package has 9 slots' worth of inventory, so it's great for moving a bunch of items around at once. To craft the Packager, you need plenty of Wrought Iron and an Electron Tube, not to mention a bunch of Cardboard (Paper and Glue).",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Note that once crafted, the packager works without any additional cardboard, so don't worry about upkeep!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Putting a Sign on the Packager will make it automatically label the sign's contents onto all packages as a destination address. This will be more useful once you start working with various ways to route packages around.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Packagers can also unwrap any packages that get put into it, unloading their contents into the attached inventory.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Note that Framed Signs do not work for this purpose!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Pack it up",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Packages can be routed using the specialized Package Filter, which can be used just like any filter in any Create machine that supports filter slots. Just right click while holding the filter and type in the address that should be filtered, and any packages with that specified destination address will be let through. This is useful especially for Brass Tunnels to make your belt network route your packages around based on destination.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The general solution to package routing",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Package Filters",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Package Frogports are one of three ways you can move packages around and get them to where you want them to be. They can hang packages onto Chain Conveyor lines be transported along the chain connections. To use them, you first need a network of Chain Conveyors connected to each other using chains and then powered: Any chain with the tag #forge:chains will do. Right click on a chain connection before placing down a Frogport to have it interact with that segment of chain.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Frogports placed directly on top of a Packager automatically hang up packages that are created in said Packager.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Frogports can also receive packages in addition to sending them. If you right click on a Frogport, you can see that it has a name you can edit. This name acts as an address - if any packages that are labelled with a destination address matches its name, the Frogport will automatically collect them by taking them off the chain network! This collected package will be put into the inventory of the block the Frogport is placed on.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "As long as the chain network is connected to the input and output Frogports somehow, the package will eventually find its way, although you may want to optimize the paths to reduce package travel time on your own.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The chain of command",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Package Frogports",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Postboxes are used to route packages around using Train Networks. You first right click a Train Station to link the Postbox to that station before placing it, and from then on any trains that stop there will be able to interact with the Postbox (given it is within 4 blocks of the station).",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Much like Package Frogports, they can be named. Passing trains will then pick up any packages whose destination does not match the Postbox's name. Furthermore, if the train has any packages in its inventories that do match the Postbox, they will be passed into the Postbox's inventory instead.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "One last cool thing about Postboxes is that when extracting automatically from them (via chutes, funnels, etc), only packages with a destination that matches the Postbox's name will be taken out and any packages with a different destination will remain inside to be loaded onto trains later.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "You've got mail",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Here are some other important things that may be useful when trying to route packages around:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Packages are randomly created from a selection of four possible items, so stuff like GregTech's Item Filters will be very tedious to set up! We recommend using the Package Filter wherever you can, but...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- If you really want to try using other methods to move packages around, the destination address is stored as NBT data in the tag Address. For example, a package with the destination address \"Home\" will have in its NBT data: {Address:\"Home\"}.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Package address filtering actually supports a simplified form of RegEx. This means you can:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Match any length string with *",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Match any single character with ?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Match a single character from a group of characters surrounded by [] (e.g. A[cr]t will match 'Act' and 'Art', but not 'Ant')",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Match a single character that does not belong to a group of characters surrounded by [! ] (e.g. A[!cr]t will match 'Aft' and 'Apt', but not 'Act' or 'Art')",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Match a string from a list of strings given inside {}(e.g. TerraFirma{Craft,Greg} will match both TerraFirmaCraft and TerraFirmaGreg)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- All previous symbols can be escaped; For example, A\\* will be read as A* and only match 'A*'.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Other information on packages and addresses",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Other Information",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Tell me more",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Whichever way you obtained the materials needed, you need a Lathe or Belt Grinder to actually create the Lens. Either a Basic Lathe or Belt Grinder will be enough to create the lens from an Exquisite Rose Quartz gem, but if you want to make the lens from a mere plate you will need better equipment in the form of an Advanced Lathe.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Once you've crafted it, the lens can be used in a Basic Laser Engraver with a Double Red Alloy Plate to create the Transmitter unit you need, and won't be consumed in the process.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Note: Once you make it to MV, you'll be able to make more Rose Quartz at home - just be sure to reserve at least one Rose Quartz Gem for it!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "YONO (You Only Need One)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Rose-tinted Glasses",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Moving packages around is good and all, but surely that can't be all there is? Well, you're exactly right. There's much more that can be done with packages, including reading inventory contents and having things be delivered remotely, and later on even automatically sending ingredients to be processed based on an item's threshold!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "But before delving into High Logistics, some preparations are in order.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The Transmitters that would be required for crafting such equipment can only realistically be produced via high-energy light refracted through a very unique mineral: Rose Quartz. In other words, we need both a Basic Laser Engraver and some way of obtaining a Rose Quartz Lens, so you better get to getting these done, eh?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "...But Rose Quartz is Pink",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Roses are red...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "one_started",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The only natural source of Rose Quartz of a high enough quality to easily craft the Lens out of is located far, far to the north in freezing temperatures (below -10°C). Getting Kaolin clay flashbacks yet?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Rose Quartz only forms in the cores of ancient glaciers. Although not common, the glacier core is easily identified by their Blue Ice outer shells. The Rose Quartz will be found inside - first as ore, then as compressed raw ore blocks in the very center.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "What we need is Exquisite Rose Quartz, which you can get by crushing, washing, and then sifting the raw ore you mined; The Exquisite gem has a 3 percent chance of being sifted out, but you only need one such gem to proceed.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Do not smelt the ore as this will only get you normal quality Rose Quartz!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The same preparations you once may have made for Kaolin clay will apply here as well: Prepare a lot of food, a source of portable water to drink, and some transportation (boats are nice, but aircraft should be well within your reach at this point).",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "If you created your world prior to TFG 0.12 or are using the older worldgen, rose quartz can be found in low elevation biomes such as the Ocean, Shores, and Lowlands. Otherwise, if you're using the new worldgen, you'll want to look for Ice Sheets and Glaciers.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The North Remembers",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Finding Rose Quartz",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The first High Logistics machine you can make is a Stock Link, which can be used to create a Logistics Network. When placed onto any side of a Packager, the Stock Link will make the inventory the Packager is attached to visible to the network! On its own, the Stock Link isn't super useful, but it is a core component of all the other machines yet to come...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Remember to right click on an existing Stock Link before placing one down to tune the two to share the same network. To cancel this, you can simply craft the Stock Link by itself to clear its attunement.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "We got storage buses at home",

        },

          "text": "Industrial lamps are available in all 16 colors, and in small and large sizes. By default, these will all emit normal white light; however, if you have Shimmer, each light will emit its respective color.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Industrial Lamps",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {

          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit.json",
          "text": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit.json",
          "text": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit.json",
          "text": "The netherite space suit is an upgraded version of the standard space suit, featuring permanent fire resistance, more protection and the ability to survive on Venus and Mercury. Before you travel to these planets, you must craft the netherite space suit armour or else you will burn to death.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors.json",
          "text": "Sliding Doors",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Sliding Doors",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors.json",
          "text": "Sliding Doors",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Sliding Doors",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors.json",
          "text": "Sliding doors are large 3x3 doors. They seal oxygen when closed, making them great candidates for airlocks. They can be locked by shift-right-clicking them with a wrench. Locked doors can only be opened with redstone.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Sliding Doors",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates.json",
          "text": "Creating Plates",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Creating Plates",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates.json",
          "text": "Once you've got energy, you'll want to craft a compressor. This machine can compress ingots and blocks into plates, which are needed to craft many things.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Creating Plates",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Even after you place your rocket, you will not be able to fly just yet. To fly, you will need to fill the rocket with fuel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Obtaining Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Oil is found in large amounts spouting over the ocean surface. Collect as much oil as you can, as oil is non-renewable, and you need a lot of it for each rocket launch.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Obtaining Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "After collecting enough oil (at least six buckets for a launch and return), you will need to refine the oil into fuel. To do this, you will need to craft a fuel refinery. Power it, then place the oil in the left slot, and it will be refined into fuel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Fuel Refinery",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Shift-click on the rocket to open its inventory, then place three buckets of fuel into the input slot. Place the other three buckets into the rocket's inventory for a return trip.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy.json",
          "text": "Generating Energy",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Generating Energy",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy.json",
          "text": "Coal Generator",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Generating Energy",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy.json",
          "text": "Energy is core resource of Ad Astra. It's used in all machines and is required for everything. There are multiple ways to generate energy, the most basic way being the coal generator. It uses burnable resources like wood or coal to generate energy.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Generating Energy",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel.json",
          "text": "Making Steel",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Making Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel.json",
          "text": "Etrionic Blast Furnace",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Making Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel.json",
          "text": "The Etrionic Blast Furnace is an upgraded version of the blast furnace. It has two modes: blasting and alloying. Blasting works like a blast furnace, but with 4 slots for 4x efficiency. Alloying combines materials to make an alloy.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Making Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel.json",
          "text": "Steel is made in an etrionic blast furnace by combining iron and coal. This will make 1 steel ingot per iron and coal. Steel is essential for most recipes and is the main material of your first rocket.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Making Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen.json",
          "text": "At this point, you can launch your rocket; however, you will likely die very fast, as there is no oxygen on the moon. In order to survive on the moon, you will need an oxygenated space suit and an ample oxygen supply.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Oxygen",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen.json",
          "text": "To obtain oxygen, it must be extracted from water. An oxygen loader is required to do this. Craft one, then place water in the left tank, and watch it convert into oxygen. You must repeat this process many times until you have enough oxygen.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Oxygen",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen.json",
          "text": "Oxygen Loader",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.title",
          "label": "Oxygen",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen.json",
          "text": "Oxygen can then be extracted by collecting it in a bucket, spacesuit, or a gas tank. After you have enough oxygen, you are moments away from launching your first rocket!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Oxygen",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources.json",
          "text": "Portable Resources",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Portable Resources",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources.json",
          "text": "Gas Tanks",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Portable Resources",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources.json",
          "text": "Oxygen tanks allow you to store oxygen in a convenient portable form. Despite the name, they can store any fluid. Holding down right-click will distribute the oxygen into items in your inventory, with a bias towards armor.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Portable Resources",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources.json",
          "text": "Etrionic Capacitor",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Portable Resources",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources.json",
          "text": "The Etrionic Capacitor is a battery-like item for storing energy in a portable form. It can be placed in the energy slot of machines to power them, and like the gas tanks, can be distributed into your inventory by holding down right-click. It features two modes: Sequential and Round Robin. Sequential will distribute energy one by one while Round Robin will distribute energy evenly. The mode can be changed by right-clicking while sneaking.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Portable Resources",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/radio",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/radio.json",
          "text": "Before launching, why not listen to some tunes? The radio is a block that'll play real internet-streamed radio stations! There are a few stations that you can listen to, in multiple genres. In addition, anyone in the vicinity will hear the same station. Eventually, you'll be able to use the radio to craft the rover, which features a built-in radio for driving around and listening to music.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Radio",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket.json",
          "text": "Your First Rocket",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Your First Rocket",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket.json",
          "text": "NASA Workbench",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Your First Rocket",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket.json",
          "text": "In order to build a rocket, you must first collect all of the parts: cone, plates, fins, tanks and engine. You can then make the rocket in a NASA workbench, a specially designed workbench just for rockets.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Your First Rocket",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket.json",
          "text": "NASA Workbench",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Your First Rocket",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket.json",
          "text": "To place your newly-created rocket, you must build a launchpad.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Your First Rocket",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "In addition, some ores are Graded. Ore blocks may be Poor, Normal, or Rich, and different veins will have different concentrations of each type of block. Veins that are richer are more lucrative. The next several pages show the different types of ores, what they look like, and where to find them.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Native Copper is an ore of Copper metal. It can be found in Igneous Extrusive rocks, at elevations above y=40. It can also be found in deposits in rivers, which can be panned.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Native Copper",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Native Copper Ores in Dacite.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Native Gold is an ore of Gold metal. It can be found at elevations below y=70, but deeper veins are larger and richer. It can be found in Igneous Extrusive and Igneous Intrusive rocks. It can also be found in deposits in rivers, which can be panned.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Native Gold",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.title",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Native Gold Ores in Diorite.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Native Silver is an ore of Silver metal. Small poor veins can be found in Granite or Diorite in uplift regions, above y=90. Larger and richer veins can be found in Granite, Diorite, Schist, and Gneiss deep underground below y=20. It can also be found in deposits in rivers, which can be panned.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Native Silver",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.title",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",

          "count": 60
        },

          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",

          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Tetrahedrite is an ore of Copper metal. It can be found at any elevation, but deeper veins are often richer. It can be found in Metamorphic rocks.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Tetrahedrite Ores in Schist.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "text": "Malachite is an ore of Copper metal. It can be found primarily in Marble or Limestone, Chalk, and Dolomite. It can be found at most elevations, however deeper veins are often larger and richer.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Malachite Ores in Marble.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Cassiterite is an ore of Tin metal. It can be found in Igneous Intrusive rocks at high elevation, above y=80 in uplift regions or in dikes. It can also be found in deposits in rivers, which can be panned.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Cassiterite Ores in Diorite.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",

          "text": "Bismuthinite is an ore of Bismuth metal. It can be found in Sedimentary rocks near the surface, or larger and richer veins in Igneous Intrusive rocks deep underground.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },

          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Bismuthinite Ores in Shale.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.15.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60

          "text": "Garnierite is an ore of Nickel metal. It can be found at elevations below y=0. It can be found primarily in Gabbro deep underground. Smaller, rarer veins can also be found in any Igneous Intrusive rock.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },

          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Garnierite Ores in Gabbro.",

          "text": "Hematite is an ore of Iron metal. It can be found in large veins in any Igneous Extrusive rocks near the surface.",

          "text": "Hematite Ores in Andesite.",

          "text": "Magnetite is an ore of Iron metal. It can be found in large veins in any Sedimentary rocks near the surface.",

        },

          "text": "Sphalerite is an ore of Zinc metal. Small, poor veins can be found in Igneous Extrusive rocks near the surface, and large richer veins can be found in Igneous Intrusive rocks deep underground.",

        },
        {

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",

          "text": "Lignite is a type of low-grade Coal ore. It can be found in very large flat deposits near the surface in Sedimentary rocks.",

          "text": "Bituminous Coal is a type of mid-grade Coal ore. It can be found in very large flat deposits near the surface in Sedimentary rocks.",

          "text": "Kaolinite is a soft Mineral which is used in the construction of Fire Clay. It can be found spawning at high altitudes in Plateaus, Old Mountains, and Highlands, at a temperature of at least 18°C, with a rainfall of at least 300mm. The Blood Lily flower grows on Kaolin clay.",

          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Variants of kaolin clay.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.31.text",

          "text": "Graphite is a Mineral which is used in the construction of Fire Clay. It can be found in Gneiss, Marble, Quartzite, and Schist rocks, in elevations below y=60 and above y=-30.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.32.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Graphite in Gneiss.",

          "label": "Ores and Minerals",

          "count": 60
        },

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Crafting the Ultimate Battery marks the end of GTCEu and the GregTech Community Modpack. Congratulations!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Now that you've finished the mod, there's a few things you should do:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Join the GTCEu Discord and tell us about how your playthrough went! Feel free to show off your battery :)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Go outside (and start playing GregTech in real life, right?). Integrate back into regular society.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Blow up your world with TNT and GT Dynamite. Please, please, PLEASE make a backup first!!!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Thank you for playing the pack! :D",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- The GregTech Community Pack Dev Team",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Is this... the end?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Thanks for playing!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Finale",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This Maintenance Hatch is an upgrade to the Automatic Maintenance Hatch.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It allows your Multiblock to run regular Cleanroom recipes when not contained inside one - but not Sterilized recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Cleaning Maintenance Hatch",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The UV Lapotronic Orb is even better than the ZPM one! It of course comes at a price...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: Imagine making 512 IV Orbs, or 64 LuV Orbs... or 8 ZPM Orbs.... for just one of these! See the Lore for the LuV orb for details.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It holds way too much power!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Ultimate Battery?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The amount of EU this battery can store is the max value of a Long Integer in Java.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't try to win Minecraft - you can't.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: You're probably tired of this by now, but things are different with the battery lore this time. We promise.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "GTCEu's ultimate battery uses 16 UV orbs. GTNH's only uses 8. However, GTNH also has a Really Ultimate Battery made of 8 Ultimate Batteries! It's not useful at all, but still exists...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "They also added an Extremely Ultimate Battery made of 8 Really Ultimate Batteries, which is ludicrously expensive.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Consider touching some grass",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Ultimate Battery!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Network Switch allows multiple HPCAs to be used in conjunction with each other! This allows you to provide far more computation to your Research Station.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HPCAs can be connected to Network Switches with transmission and reception hatches, and then the Network Switch can output to a Research Station with another transmission hatch.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HPCAs cannot connect to Network Switches by default, and each connected HPCA requires an HPCA Bridge Component to enable this functionality.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "With our powers combined...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Network Switch",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This is a huge accomplishment, nice job!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        }

          "text": "Ores and Minerals in TFC are rare - unlike Vanilla, ores are found in massive, sparse, yet rare veins that require some prospecting to locate.           "count": 60

        {

          "text": "In addition, some ores are Graded. Ore blocks may be Poor, Normal, or Rich, and different veins will have different concentrations of each type of block.           "text": "Tetrahedrite Ores in Schist.",

          "text": "Malachite is an ore of Copper metal. It can be found primarily in Marble or Limestone, Chalk, and Dolomite. It can be found at most elevations, however deeper veins are often larger and richer.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60
        },

          "text": "Malachite Ores in Marble.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 32,
          "count": 60

          "text": "Cassiterite is an ore of Tin metal. It can be found in Igneous Intrusive rocks at high elevation, above y=80 in uplift regions or in dikes. It can also be found in deposits in rivers, which can be panned.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",

          "text": "Cassiterite Ores in Diorite.",

          "item_ref_count": 32,

          "text": "Bismuthinite is an ore of Bismuth metal. It can be found in Sedimentary rocks near the surface, or larger and richer veins in Igneous Intrusive rocks deep underground.",

          "label": "Ores and Minerals",

          "text": "Garnierite is an ore of Nickel metal. It can be found at elevations below y=0. It can be found primarily in Gabbro deep underground. Smaller, rarer veins can also be found in any Igneous Intrusive rock.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",

          "text": "Kaolinite is a soft Mineral which is used in the construction of Fire Clay. It can be found spawning at high altitudes in Plateaus, Old Mountains, and Highlands, at a temperature of at least 18°C, with a rainfall of at least 300mm. The Blood Lily flower grows on Kaolin clay.",

          "text": "Graphite is a Mineral which is used in the construction of Fire Clay. It can be found in Gneiss, Marble, Quartzite, and Schist rocks, in elevations below y=60 and above y=-30.",

          "text": "Cinnabar is a Mineral which can be ground in the Quern to obtain Redstone Dust. It can be found in veins deep underground, in Quartzite, Gneiss, Phyllite, and Schist.",

          "text": "Saltpeter is a Mineral which can be ground in the Quern, and then used in the crafting of Gunpowder. It can be found in very large flat deposits near the surface in Sedimentary rocks.",

          "text": "Sulfur is a Mineral which can be ground in the Quern, and then used in the crafting of Gunpowder. It is found near lava level deep underground, in sparse but large and plentiful veins, in any Metamorphic or Igneous Intrusive rock.",

          "text": "Sylvite is a Mineral which can be ground in the Quern, and then used as a Fertilizer. It can be found in very large flat deposits near the surface in Shale, Claystone and Chert.",
