          "text": "Sliding doors are large 3x3 doors. They seal oxygen when closed, making them great candidates for airlocks. They can be locked by shift-right-clicking them with a wrench. Locked doors can only be opened with redstone.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Sliding Doors",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/trophies",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/trophies.json",
          "text": "Globes are trophy blocks found as a reward at the end of a dungeon. Globes offer no practical function and are instead a decoration block. They can be spun around by right-clicking or can spin forever when powered by redstone. Only the Moon globe is obtainable in survival at the moment.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Trophies",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/trophies",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/trophies.json",
          "text": "Space Paintings",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Trophies",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/trophies",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/trophies.json",
          "text": "Space paintings are found in chests throughout dungeons. They work exactly like regular paintings but only place paintings from this mod. There are 14 pieces to look for.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Trophies",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury.json",
          "text": "Venus and Mercury",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Venus and Mercury",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury.json",
          "text": "Once you have enough Ostrum to craft a complete netherite space suit set and all of the components of the tier three rocket, you can travel to Venus and Mercury. Please note that if you enter these planets without a netherite space suit or fire resistance, you will die very fast. The next material that you seek is Calorite.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Venus and Mercury",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/venus_and_mercury.json",
          "text": "Calorite is used to craft the ultimate rocket capable of travelling to a new solar system.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Venus and Mercury",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates.json",
          "text": "Creating Plates",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Creating Plates",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates.json",
          "text": "Once you've got energy, you'll want to craft a compressor. This machine can compress ingots and blocks into plates, which are needed to craft many things.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Creating Plates",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Even after you place your rocket, you will not be able to fly just yet. To fly, you will need to fill the rocket with fuel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Obtaining Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Oil is found in large amounts spouting over the ocean surface. Collect as much oil as you can, as oil is non-renewable, and you need a lot of it for each rocket launch.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Obtaining Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "After collecting enough oil (at least six buckets for a launch and return), you will need to refine the oil into fuel. To do this, you will need to craft a fuel refinery. Power it, then place the oil in the left slot, and it will be refined into fuel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Fuel Refinery",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Shift-click on the rocket to open its inventory, then place three buckets of fuel into the input slot. Place the other three buckets into the rocket's inventory for a return trip.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy.json",
          "text": "Generating Energy",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Generating Energy",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy.json",
          "text": "Coal Generator",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Generating Energy",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy.json",
          "text": "Energy is core resource of Ad Astra. It's used in all machines and is required for everything. There are multiple ways to generate energy, the most basic way being the coal generator. It uses burnable resources like wood or coal to generate energy.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Generating Energy",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel.json",
          "text": "Making Steel",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Making Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel.json",
          "text": "Etrionic Blast Furnace",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Making Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel.json",
          "text": "The Etrionic Blast Furnace is an upgraded version of the blast furnace. It has two modes: blasting and alloying. Blasting works like a blast furnace, but with 4 slots for 4x efficiency. Alloying combines materials to make an alloy.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Making Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "text": "At this point, you can launch your rocket; however, you will likely die very fast, as there is no oxygen on the moon. In order to survive on the moon, you will need an oxygenated space suit and an ample oxygen supply.",

        {

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "By utilising a few machines from Create, you'll be able to improve your item transportation and storage capabilities significantly. Later on once you progress into the Voltaic Age, you'll even be able to set up processes to automatically order specific items or route them around your base as needed!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "As this questline deals primarily with machines from Create, this means Pondering the machines will be your best source of information aside from these quests, so be sure to look through their entries.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Boxing Clever",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "all_started",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "When provided with a redstone signal, the Packager will wrap up items from the block it is attached to (you can switch the connection side with a wrench) and output a neat little cardboard package. Each cardboard package has 9 slots' worth of inventory, so it's great for moving a bunch of items around at once. To craft the Packager, you need plenty of Wrought Iron and an Electron Tube, not to mention a bunch of Cardboard (Paper and Glue).",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Note that once crafted, the packager works without any additional cardboard, so don't worry about upkeep!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Putting a Sign on the Packager will make it automatically label the sign's contents onto all packages as a destination address. This will be more useful once you start working with various ways to route packages around.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Packagers can also unwrap any packages that get put into it, unloading their contents into the attached inventory.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Note that Framed Signs do not work for this purpose!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Pack it up",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Packages can be routed using the specialized Package Filter, which can be used just like any filter in any Create machine that supports filter slots. Just right click while holding the filter and type in the address that should be filtered, and any packages with that specified destination address will be let through. This is useful especially for Brass Tunnels to make your belt network route your packages around based on destination.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The general solution to package routing",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Package Filters",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Package Frogports are one of three ways you can move packages around and get them to where you want them to be. They can hang packages onto Chain Conveyor lines be transported along the chain connections. To use them, you first need a network of Chain Conveyors connected to each other using chains and then powered: Any chain with the tag #forge:chains will do. Right click on a chain connection before placing down a Frogport to have it interact with that segment of chain.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Frogports placed directly on top of a Packager automatically hang up packages that are created in said Packager.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Frogports can also receive packages in addition to sending them. If you right click on a Frogport, you can see that it has a name you can edit. This name acts as an address - if any packages that are labelled with a destination address matches its name, the Frogport will automatically collect them by taking them off the chain network! This collected package will be put into the inventory of the block the Frogport is placed on.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "As long as the chain network is connected to the input and output Frogports somehow, the package will eventually find its way, although you may want to optimize the paths to reduce package travel time on your own.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The chain of command",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Package Frogports",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Postboxes are used to route packages around using Train Networks. You first right click a Train Station to link the Postbox to that station before placing it, and from then on any trains that stop there will be able to interact with the Postbox (given it is within 4 blocks of the station).",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Much like Package Frogports, they can be named. Passing trains will then pick up any packages whose destination does not match the Postbox's name. Furthermore, if the train has any packages in its inventories that do match the Postbox, they will be passed into the Postbox's inventory instead.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "One last cool thing about Postboxes is that when extracting automatically from them (via chutes, funnels, etc), only packages with a destination that matches the Postbox's name will be taken out and any packages with a different destination will remain inside to be loaded onto trains later.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },

          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "You've got mail",

          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Here are some other important things that may be useful when trying to route packages around:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Packages are randomly created from a selection of four possible items, so stuff like GregTech's Item Filters will be very tedious to set up! We recommend using the Package Filter wherever you can, but...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- If you really want to try using other methods to move packages around, the destination address is stored as NBT data in the tag Address. For example, a package with the destination address \"Home\" will have in its NBT data: {Address:\"Home\"}.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Package address filtering actually supports a simplified form of RegEx. This means you can:",

          "label": "create_logistics",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Match any length string with *",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Match any single character with ?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Match a single character from a group of characters surrounded by [] (e.g. A[cr]t will match 'Act' and 'Art', but not 'Ant')",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "- Match a single character that does not belong to a group of characters surrounded by [! ] (e.g. A[!cr]t will match 'Aft' and 'Apt', but not 'Act' or 'Art')",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16

        {

          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Note: Once you make it to MV, you'll be able to make more Rose Quartz at home - just be sure to reserve at least one Rose Quartz Gem for it!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "YONO (You Only Need One)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Rose-tinted Glasses",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Moving packages around is good and all, but surely that can't be all there is? Well, you're exactly right. There's much more that can be done with packages, including reading inventory contents and having things be delivered remotely, and later on even automatically sending ingredients to be processed based on an item's threshold!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "But before delving into High Logistics, some preparations are in order.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The Transmitters that would be required for crafting such equipment can only realistically be produced via high-energy light refracted through a very unique mineral: Rose Quartz. In other words, we need both a Basic Laser Engraver and some way of obtaining a Rose Quartz Lens, so you better get to getting these done, eh?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "...But Rose Quartz is Pink",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Roses are red...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "one_started",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The only natural source of Rose Quartz of a high enough quality to easily craft the Lens out of is located far, far to the north in freezing temperatures (below -10°C). Getting Kaolin clay flashbacks yet?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Rose Quartz only forms in the cores of ancient glaciers. Although not common, the glacier core is easily identified by their Blue Ice outer shells. The Rose Quartz will be found inside - first as ore, then as compressed raw ore blocks in the very center.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "What we need is Exquisite Rose Quartz, which you can get by crushing, washing, and then sifting the raw ore you mined; The Exquisite gem has a 3 percent chance of being sifted out, but you only need one such gem to proceed.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Do not smelt the ore as this will only get you normal quality Rose Quartz!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The same preparations you once may have made for Kaolin clay will apply here as well: Prepare a lot of food, a source of portable water to drink, and some transportation (boats are nice, but aircraft should be well within your reach at this point).",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "If you created your world prior to TFG 0.12 or are using the older worldgen, rose quartz can be found in low elevation biomes such as the Ocean, Shores, and Lowlands. Otherwise, if you're using the new worldgen, you'll want to look for Ice Sheets and Glaciers.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The North Remembers",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Finding Rose Quartz",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "The first High Logistics machine you can make is a Stock Link, which can be used to create a Logistics Network. When placed onto any side of a Packager, the Stock Link will make the inventory the Packager is attached to visible to the network! On its own, the Stock Link isn't super useful, but it is a core component of all the other machines yet to come...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Remember to right click on an existing Stock Link before placing one down to tune the two to share the same network. To cancel this, you can simply craft the Stock Link by itself to clear its attunement.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "We got storage buses at home",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Stock Link",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "If you've already used Stock Links to provide various items to a Logistics Network, the next step is to make something that can call in said items remotely... And that's where the Stock Ticker comes in. Much like the Stock Link, you first need to right click an existing link to attune the Ticker to that network. You then need to place down a Blaze Burner or any mob in a Seat next to the Stock Ticker to have them work as a Stock Keeper.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/create_logistics",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/create_logistics.snbt",
          "text": "Now that the poor creature is indentured for life, you can click on them to see all the items on the Logistics Network. You can even search for items in the network, and create an order to be sent to specific addresses! There's no range limitation for this, although you do need to create your own way of routing around the packages that will be ordered through the Stock Links as well as have the link in question chunkloaded for this to work.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "create_logistics",
          "item_ref_count": 16
        }
      ],
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Candidate player storage section inferred from pack evidence; accept only if it is a useful way to group items."

          "text": "Industrial lamps are available in all 16 colors, and in small and large sizes. By default, these will all emit normal white light; however, if you have Shimmer, each light will emit its respective color.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Industrial Lamps",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit.json",
          "text": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit.json",
          "text": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/netherite_space_suit.json",
          "text": "The netherite space suit is an upgraded version of the standard space suit, featuring permanent fire resistance, more protection and the ability to survive on Venus and Mercury. Before you travel to these planets, you must craft the netherite space suit armour or else you will burn to death.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Netherite Space Suit",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors.json",
          "text": "Sliding Doors",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Sliding Doors",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors.json",
          "text": "Sliding Doors",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Sliding Doors",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/sliding_doors.json",
          "text": "Sliding doors are large 3x3 doors. They seal oxygen when closed, making them great candidates for airlocks. They can be locked by shift-right-clicking them with a wrench. Locked doors can only be opened with redstone.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Sliding Doors",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates.json",
          "text": "Creating Plates",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Creating Plates",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/creating_plates.json",
          "text": "Once you've got energy, you'll want to craft a compressor. This machine can compress ingots and blocks into plates, which are needed to craft many things.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Creating Plates",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Even after you place your rocket, you will not be able to fly just yet. To fly, you will need to fill the rocket with fuel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Obtaining Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Oil is found in large amounts spouting over the ocean surface. Collect as much oil as you can, as oil is non-renewable, and you need a lot of it for each rocket launch.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Obtaining Fuel",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "After collecting enough oil (at least six buckets for a launch and return), you will need to refine the oil into fuel. To do this, you will need to craft a fuel refinery. Power it, then place the oil in the left slot, and it will be refined into fuel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Fuel Refinery",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/fuel.json",
          "text": "Shift-click on the rocket to open its inventory, then place three buckets of fuel into the input slot. Place the other three buckets into the rocket's inventory for a return trip.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy.json",
          "text": "Generating Energy",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Generating Energy",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy.json",
          "text": "Coal Generator",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Generating Energy",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/generating_energy.json",
          "text": "Energy is core resource of Ad Astra. It's used in all machines and is required for everything. There are multiple ways to generate energy, the most basic way being the coal generator. It uses burnable resources like wood or coal to generate energy.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Generating Energy",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel.json",
          "text": "Making Steel",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Making Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel.json",
          "text": "Etrionic Blast Furnace",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Making Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel.json",
          "text": "The Etrionic Blast Furnace is an upgraded version of the blast furnace. It has two modes: blasting and alloying. Blasting works like a blast furnace, but with 4 slots for 4x efficiency. Alloying combines materials to make an alloy.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Making Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/making_steel.json",
          "text": "Steel is made in an etrionic blast furnace by combining iron and coal. This will make 1 steel ingot per iron and coal. Steel is essential for most recipes and is the main material of your first rocket.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Making Steel",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen.json",
          "text": "At this point, you can launch your rocket; however, you will likely die very fast, as there is no oxygen on the moon. In order to survive on the moon, you will need an oxygenated space suit and an ample oxygen supply.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Oxygen",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen.json",
          "text": "To obtain oxygen, it must be extracted from water. An oxygen loader is required to do this. Craft one, then place water in the left tank, and watch it convert into oxygen. You must repeat this process many times until you have enough oxygen.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Oxygen",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen.json",
          "text": "Oxygen Loader",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.title",
          "label": "Oxygen",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/oxygen.json",
          "text": "Oxygen can then be extracted by collecting it in a bucket, spacesuit, or a gas tank. After you have enough oxygen, you are moments away from launching your first rocket!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Oxygen",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources.json",
          "text": "Portable Resources",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Portable Resources",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources.json",
          "text": "Gas Tanks",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Portable Resources",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources.json",
          "text": "Oxygen tanks allow you to store oxygen in a convenient portable form. Despite the name, they can store any fluid. Holding down right-click will distribute the oxygen into items in your inventory, with a bias towards armor.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Portable Resources",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources.json",
          "text": "Etrionic Capacitor",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Portable Resources",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/portable_resources.json",
          "text": "The Etrionic Capacitor is a battery-like item for storing energy in a portable form. It can be placed in the energy slot of machines to power them, and like the gas tanks, can be distributed into your inventory by holding down right-click. It features two modes: Sequential and Round Robin. Sequential will distribute energy one by one while Round Robin will distribute energy evenly. The mode can be changed by right-clicking while sneaking.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Portable Resources",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/radio",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/radio.json",
          "text": "Before launching, why not listen to some tunes? The radio is a block that'll play real internet-streamed radio stations! There are a few stations that you can listen to, in multiple genres. In addition, anyone in the vicinity will hear the same station. Eventually, you'll be able to use the radio to craft the rover, which features a built-in radio for driving around and listening to music.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Radio",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket.json",
          "text": "Your First Rocket",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Your First Rocket",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket.json",
          "text": "NASA Workbench",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Your First Rocket",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket.json",
          "text": "In order to build a rocket, you must first collect all of the parts: cone, plates, fins, tanks and engine. You can then make the rocket in a NASA workbench, a specially designed workbench just for rockets.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Your First Rocket",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket.json",
          "text": "NASA Workbench",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Your First Rocket",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket.json",
          "text": "To place your newly-created rocket, you must build a launchpad.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Your First Rocket",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/your_first_rocket.json",
          "text": "After the launch pad has been built, place the rocket in the center. If you want, you can power any part of the launch pad to automatically launch the rocket once fueled.",

          "text": "Energy is core resource of Ad Astra. It's used in all machines and is required for everything. There are multiple ways to generate energy, the most basic way being the coal generator. It uses burnable resources like wood or coal to generate energy.",

          "text": "The Etrionic Blast Furnace is an upgraded version of the blast furnace. It has two modes: blasting and alloying. Blasting works like a blast furnace, but with 4 slots for 4x efficiency. Alloying combines materials to make an alloy.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",

          "text": "Steel is made in an etrionic blast furnace by combining iron and coal. This will make 1 steel ingot per iron and coal. Steel is essential for most recipes and is the main material of your first rocket.",

          "text": "At this point, you can launch your rocket; however, you will likely die very fast, as there is no oxygen on the moon. In order to survive on the moon, you will need an oxygenated space suit and an ample oxygen supply.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Oxygen",

          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {

          "text": "To obtain oxygen, it must be extracted from water. An oxygen loader is required to do this. Craft one, then place water in the left tank, and watch it convert into oxygen. You must repeat this process many times until you have enough oxygen.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Oxygen",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },

          "recipe_ref_count": 3,

        },

          "text": "Oxygen can then be extracted by collecting it in a bucket, spacesuit, or a gas tank. After you have enough oxygen, you are moments away from launching your first rocket!",

          "label": "Oxygen",

          "text": "The Etrionic Capacitor is a battery-like item for storing energy in a portable form. It features two modes: Sequential and Round Robin. Sequential will distribute energy one by one while Round Robin will distribute energy evenly. The mode can be changed by right-clicking while sneaking.",

          "text": "The Jet Suit is an upgraded version of the Netherite Space Suit, with more protection, additional oxygen storage, and flight. It's expensive to craft, but it offers high-speed flight, making travel easy.",
