      "semantic_evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Pyrolyse Oven is an electric equivalent to the Coke Oven. It can produce Coal Coke and Charcoal with a Creosote byproduct just as before, but also has additional Organic Byproducts, the most beneficial of these being Wood Tar.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Another product is Biomass, which is more pertinent for your progression as of this moment.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The byproducts can be Distilled for an array of organic resources, with different byproducts giving different ratios of different chemicals.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You will need to take a peek at the Distillation Quest to get to grips with the power of distillation...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "There are recipes that can accept Nitrogen to double the speed. This isn't quite worth pursuing right now, but Nitrogen will eventually be free and infinite.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You should be more than fine with a single LV Energy Hatch, and Superconductors to supply a steady 64 EU/t. Additionally, Cupronickel Coils are perfect when you're getting used to the Pyrolyse Oven, but you may want to upgrade to Kanthal eventually.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: The Plant path is one path you can take towards Ethylene, which is a necessary chemical in progressing to HV. The other path involves Oil.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Pyrolyse Oven remains optional. However, it is very rewarding to construct one either for Power, or for the various Byproducts, and we highly recommend you give it a look.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: In GT5u, the structure for the Pyrolyse Oven was infamously a giant box with only 9 coils inside. Players usually spent several minutes debugging what is wrong due to a lack of a EMI preview.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Thermal Decomposition",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Pyrolyse Oven",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Welcome to the organic Ethylene path! The goal here is to produce Ethanol and mix it with Sulfuric Acid to make Ethylene.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "To get Ethanol, you'll need to distill it from Biomass—so let's look at the different ways to produce that biomass.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The first method is simple: put saplings into a Brewery with water. The downside? It's slow.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The second method is more complex, but yields much better results. You’ll need to get Bio Chaff, which comes from macerating Plant Balls. Note that you won't get any extra chance until you unlock HV Crushing.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Plant Balls can be obtained by:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "-Centrifuging Sugarcane or Beets",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "-Centrifuging every wood that you can tap #afc:tappable_logs",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "-Compressing saplings directly",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Finally, process your Bio Chaff with water in a Brewery or go for a Pyrolyse Oven for a 66 percent boost in output.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: You may recognise Plantballs from IndustrialCraft2! In IC2 Experimental, there was this rather... obscure way to turn Biomass into Biogas for power, which sadly required too much investment to be really worth it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Plants aren't industrial enough!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Brewery can be used to make Lubricant from Redstone and Creosote/Oil. Lubricant has some niche uses, namely being used in the Cutter to significantly reduce the duration of its recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Brewery is a very, very slow machine, but it requires almost no power to run its recipes. Building many Breweries will help you obtain enough Biomass on your quest for plastic.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: The Brewery unlocks the Biomass path towards Ethylene. The same can be done in the Pyrolyse Oven. The other path involves Oil.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: You could make your own Brewery if you want to build up a company and start selling Booze... in GregTech 6.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "*hic*... *hic*",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:lv_brewery)item(gtceu:mv_brewery))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Local Brewery selling Booze",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Our warmest congratulations on making it here.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The way you should obtain Ethylene was described in the previous Quest, depending on the route you chose.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Ethylene will shortly be used in polymer production. It's also useful in a few other reactions.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "One of many hydrocarbons",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Click here to complete this quest/task",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Put your previously made Biomass into a MV Distillery to make Ethanol.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You will need this for Ethylene by reacting it with Sulfuric Acid in a MV Chemical Reactor... unless you chose to go down the Oil path.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Once you have a hefty starting stock of Ethanol, consider making and distilling Fermented Biomass in a Distillation Tower (when you get there!) for extra chemicals.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Do not try to use Ethanol as a Power source... it's quite possibly its worst use. If it's organic Power that you want, we suggest taking a look at Benzene instead!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Yo, wait - that's alcohol!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Distillating Oil or Raw Oil will give you Fuel that you will need to desulfurize.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Hydrogen Sulfide is perfectly recycled in an Electrolyzer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "To automate this process, simply place your Chemical Reactor and your Electrolyzer next to each other. Be sure to use your Screwdriver to enable input from the output side.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Naphtha is a good Product source, surprsingly it's also a really good fuel (we heard nerf is coming) but if you are sitting on Oil sand or you don't have Raw Oil then Light Oil may be better. Keep following the quests to the right for more details.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "We're still confused on how Naphtha is pronounced",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Naphtha or Light Oil Residue",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't panic! We'll mostly be doing this to get hydrocarbons.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "There are many ways to acquire Ethylene from Oil processing. It's easy to get lost in all the options and recipes!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The best way is to steam-crack Naphtha in a Chemical Reactor. Be sure to make the Severely Steam-Cracked version for a higher yield of Ethylene.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Once in HV, you'll have the option to do this recipe in the Cracking Unit at 100 percent efficiency. Unfortunately, the recipes you are doing with the Chemical Reactor have a loss of 50 percent.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: All of this looks and feels terribly inefficient - we hope that's strong motivation to tier up! The Distillation Tower will be a huge upgrade for petrochem, but you're not quite there... yet. Right now, you'll have to use a Distillery to get Ethylene.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Fuel and oil cracking can get complicated...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Fuel Cracking",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Hello there, and welcome to MV Energy Production.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "In this quest, we’ll go over the different options available to keep your MV machines powered and running smoothly.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "We won’t cover this in every chapter, so we highly recommend that you read the dedicated chapter on GregTech Energy for a deeper understanding of how everything works.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "For now, here are your three main options:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Use an MV Generator to directly produce MV-level energy.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Step up your LV power by using transformers, with a 4:1 ratio between LV and MV.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Convert RF using your Alternator to get MV energy directly.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Higher-tier Generators will increase their fuel consumption proportionally to their Generation rate, keeping the duration of fuels and the specific amount of energy from fuels the same. The Advanced Steam Turbine will use 5,120 mB Steam per second, equivalent to 256 mB/t.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Get any of the generators to complete this quest, but you may prefer starting off with the Advanced Steam Turbine.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The Zero Point Module (item) is a non-rechargable battery with TONS of energy stored. You may have found one of these before now, but you haven't been able to discharge it until reaching ZPM.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "These can only be found as loot from Jungle Temples. They're exceptionally rare - don't worry about finding one.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: Zero Point Module, the full name of the ZPM tier, is also from Stargate. Its namesake is a device which generated crazy amounts of energy.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Unlimited powah!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Zero Point Module",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "ZPM Superconductors are a major gate between you and a Fusion Reactor Mk2, which uses copious amounts for its structure blocks.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "You can also use them to make Superconducting Coils for cheaper.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Getting tired of all these pitch-black ingots yet?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "ZPM Superconductors",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "ZPM Components thankfully aren't too much harder than LuV.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "They use lots of Osmiridium, so make sure your platinum refining process is up to the task.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Prepare your platline!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Absolute Elation",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Enriched Naquadah is an isotope of Naquadah, Nq-528. It is radioactive and will be used in (as of yet) unimplemented nuclear reactors.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Currently, you just need it to make Trinium Coils.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadah, but radioactive!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Enriched Naquadah",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Trinium Coils bring up the Heat Capacity to 9,001K.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "These coils are required for progressing to the second half of ZPM, and beyond.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "IT'S OVER 9000!!!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Trinium Coils",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The Research Station is the upgrade to the Scanner. It's used for more advanced forms of research, and will finally allow you to perform research which requires Data Orbs and Modules.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "When running the Research Station, energy and Computation is needed. The latter is provided through an HPCA, which is explained in the next quest. It is recieved with a Computation Data Reception Hatch. Note that only one Reception Hatch is allowed in a Research Station.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "This multiblock needs computation sporadically, which means the recipe will not reverse progress if you don't supply enough - it will simply halt in-place. However, the machine will still draw energy constantly, even when recieving no computation.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "To scan items, the process is relatively similar. In the Object Holder, place the target item in the center slot, and the data storage item in the other slot. Then provide computation, and the data storage item will be updated upon completion. When running, the target item will be Locked and cannot be removed.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Note: To form this multiblock, the Object Holder must face the controller.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Your research adventures continue!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Research Station",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The UV Mainframe is required to move into Fusion Mk2.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "It's also made in the Assembly Line.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Passing over the ingredients we've already seen before, watch out for the HSS-E Frames.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "...ah, here we go!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "First UV Circuits!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The Crystal SoC is used to make cheaper Crystal Circuits. Enjoy the discount!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Crystal SoCs require ZPM Emitters, which means you need a Data Orb for their research.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "In the future, these may become more difficult to make.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: In GT5u, the texture for this item was red, and did not have the special design on it. There was a \"raw\" version with the design, but it was used for other unrelated things. Who knows why?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "When engraving it once isn't enough",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Crystal SoC",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "This hatch allows you to store more Data Storage Items than the basic one.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Don't forget that this hatch requires a Data Orb for research.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Increased storage density!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Advanced Data Access Hatch",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadria is an isotope of Naquadah, Nq-522. It's highly unstable, but it'll still be used for UV components, Fusion Mk2, and when fusing Neutronium.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadah, but radioactive-er!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Production of Sterilized Growth Medium is the final processing line in GTCEu, for now.",

          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }

          "text": "Then, soaked papyrus strips are woven together in a loom to make Unrefined Paper. Finally, it must be placed on a log and Scraped to make Paper.",

          "text": "The final step is Drying the Soaked Unrefined Paper into Unrefined Paper, Which then can be Scraped into Paper as shown before.",

          "text": "Advancing in the Tech-Tree will allow you to create paper from wood with less overall steps, check EMI for the different approaches you can take for making paper with wood.",

          "label": "Papermaking",

          "text": "Paper is either made from the processed stalk of the Papyrus crop, or from Animal Hides. Paper is useful for written materials like Books and Maps.",

          "item_ref_count": 11,

          "count": 12
        },
        {

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/papermaking",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/papermaking.json",
          "text": "Papyrus must first be cut into strips with a Knife",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Papermaking",

          "recipe_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 12
        },

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/papermaking",

          "text": "Then, papyrus strips are soaked in a Barrel of Water.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Papermaking",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 12
        },

          "text": "Then, soaked papyrus strips are woven together in a loom to make Unrefined Paper. Finally, it must be placed on a log and Scraped to make Paper.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Papermaking",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 12
        },
        {

          "text": "Parchment Paper starts with a scraped hide. Review the leather making chapter to learn how to make it. Parchment requires treatment with a few different items. First, Pumice is needed. Pumice is found on the ground near Volcanoes, or from Sluicing or Panning ore deposits with Andesite, Rhyolite, or Dacite in them.",

          "label": "Papermaking",

        },

        },

          "text": "Fuel is hard to get; it requires venturing out to the ocean, looking for oil spouts. The Cryo Freezer introduces a new way to obtain a better fuel - Cryo Fuel. Cryo Fuel is much more efficient than refined fuel, allowing you to launch a rocket with just one bucket.",

          "text": "It's created by collecting ice shards, which are found as an ore underground on cold planets. The ice shard then needs to be inserted into a Cryo Freezer, and it will convert to 25 mB of Cryo Fuel. Alternatively, you can convert ice, packed ice and blue ice to fuel.           "text": "In addition to being an excellent fuel, cryo fuel has some other features. When placed, it will damage anything inside, similar to lava. It also freezes water, allowing for an infinite ice source.",

          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Is this... the end?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Thanks for playing!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Finale",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This Maintenance Hatch is an upgrade to the Automatic Maintenance Hatch.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It allows your Multiblock to run regular Cleanroom recipes when not contained inside one - but not Sterilized recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Cleaning Maintenance Hatch",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The UV Lapotronic Orb is even better than the ZPM one! It of course comes at a price...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: Imagine making 512 IV Orbs, or 64 LuV Orbs... or 8 ZPM Orbs.... for just one of these! See the Lore for the LuV orb for details.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It holds way too much power!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Ultimate Battery?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The amount of EU this battery can store is the max value of a Long Integer in Java.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't try to win Minecraft - you can't.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: You're probably tired of this by now, but things are different with the battery lore this time. We promise.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "GTCEu's ultimate battery uses 16 UV orbs. GTNH's only uses 8. However, GTNH also has a Really Ultimate Battery made of 8 Ultimate Batteries! It's not useful at all, but still exists...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "They also added an Extremely Ultimate Battery made of 8 Really Ultimate Batteries, which is ludicrously expensive.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Consider touching some grass",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Ultimate Battery!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Network Switch allows multiple HPCAs to be used in conjunction with each other! This allows you to provide far more computation to your Research Station.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HPCAs can be connected to Network Switches with transmission and reception hatches, and then the Network Switch can output to a Research Station with another transmission hatch.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HPCAs cannot connect to Network Switches by default, and each connected HPCA requires an HPCA Bridge Component to enable this functionality.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "With our powers combined...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Network Switch",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This is a huge accomplishment, nice job!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The only ingredient that should be new to you are the Tritanium Frames.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The final circuit",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Wetware Mainframe - The UHV Circuit",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Data Module is required for Endgame Research. Assembly Lines cannot read from it using Data Access Hatches directly, and instead require the Data Bank.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Data storage sure is expensive...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Data Module",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Neutronium is a hyper-dense material normally found in the hearts of neutron stars: the collapsed cores of stars between ten and thirty times the size of the sun. It is the final primary material in GTCEu.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: In GCYL, Neutronium is unlocked at UMV-tier (called UXV in CEu). There is also Cosmic Neutronium, which is equivalent to Avaritia's Neutronium in GT5u, which was unlocked even later in GCYL!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "More Lore: Fun Fact: a single Neutronium block is approximately 2884 million metric tons and somewhere around 600000K, yet you're somehow capable of holding one with your bare hands. Don't think about it too much.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Pure Neutrons",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Tritanium Coils bring the Heat Capacity to 10,800K.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "These coils aren't needed for much, but they'll provide another perfect overclock for most recipes!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Why would you even need something this hot?!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Tritanium Coils",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "A goal if you really want to make a point.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "If you make this in a UV machine, it'll take you 10 days.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "If you overclock a Gregicality Multiblock to UEV (by using a 4A UHV hatch), you'll still be waiting for 2.5 days!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: The NAN Certificate comes from Crops++, a GT5u addon that adds a wide variety of IC2 crops.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Obtain for G.O.A.T Status",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Certificate of not being a Noob anymore",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "UV Components are a tad harder than ZPM.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "They use lots of Tritanium and Naquadria, so make sure your have enough Fusion Reactors, and a fast enough Naquadah Plant.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "They also need a lot more Computation, which means Advanced HPCA Components are now required!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Computation Needs for early UV:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- 32 CWU/t: Basic UV Components and the Network Switch",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- 48 CWU/t: UV Sensor, Emitter, and Field Generator",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Prepare your Fusion Reactors!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Total Euphoria",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This Quest will be completed with either a UV Energy Hatch... or a UV Dynamo Hatch for your Multiblock Generators.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't forget that 16 Amp variants exist!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Additionally, remember that these hatches require a Data Module for research.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/uv__ultimate_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Upgrading your Assembly Line III",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "uv__ultimate_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 29
        }
      ],
